decision.reason: Best result remains difference-combined word TF-IDF at 0.6766; char n-grams in difference mode (0.6372) and concat (0.6585) both underperformed. The difference representation likely works because it captures which headline has extra tokens, but it discards shared vocabulary. A better approach: keep the winning word difference features and re-tune logistic regression with stronger regularization and a balanced class weight, since asymmetric relatedness signals may benefit from tighter feature weighting. Try C=0.5 with class_weight balanced to reduce overfitting on the sparse difference representation.
